name: Tarique Faiyaz
bio: Mr. Tarique Faiyaz is a faculty member at the Law School, Vidyashilp University. He completed his B.A.LL.B from Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh and LL.M from Amity University, Noida, both in First Class Honours. After that he joined the Bar and has worked as a lawyer in and around Delhi. Currently he is a doctoral student at the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur, India. He has participated and presented papers in various national and international conferences. Mr. Tarique Faiyaz has completed a "Certificate Course in International Law- June 2007" organized by the Indian Society of International Law, New Delhi, India. He has extensively contributed research papers in journals of international repute on issues concerning ocean governance, maritime security, intersection of AI and the law, and transnational organized crime. He has peer-reviewed articles for Journal of the Territorial and Maritime Studies (JTMS). He is engaged in research in the fields of International Law, Ocean Governance, International Environmental Law, as well as intersections of AI and Law.

education.degree: PhD Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur (pursuing)

teaching: Completed the PhD Course, “A Law to Save the World?" from 03 November to 18 December 2020, offered by the Faculty of Law, Lund University as part of the Lund University Agenda 2030 Graduate School.

Completed the course “Ocean Sciences: Ocean Law and Governance” of the European University of Ocean Sciences at CIVIS from 10 November to 14 December 2021 conducted by the Ocean Science Institute of AIX-Marseille University.

Completed a Six Week (August 31 - October 12, 2020) MOOC on “The Blue Economy – Creating an Enabling Environment” at the Virtual University for Small States of the Commonwealth (VUSSC), hosted by the James Michel Blue Economy Research Institute, University of Seychelles and the Commonwealth of Learning.
Completed a Two Weeks (June 28 – July 09, 2021) International Law of the Sea Summer Academy Course on full scholarship, hosted by the Faculty of Law, Kadir Has University, Istanbul, Turkey.

Completed a one-week International Training Workshop on Global Ocean Governance in the New Era (13 - 17 September 2021) organized the Xiamen University Center for Oceans Law and the China Seas and China Institute for Marine Affairs, Ministry of Natural Resources, China.

Completed a 10-day Virtual Ocean Governance Course from 19th – 30th September 2022, the IOI Summer School 2022 - Ocean Governance for Sustainable Marine Ecosystems organized by Leibniz Centre for Tropical Marine Research (ZMT), Germany.

Completed the 6th IOI/DMCR one month Training Programme on Regional Ocean Governance Framework, Implementation of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) and Its Related Instruments in the Southeast Asian Seas and the Indian Ocean being conducted by the International Ocean Institute Training Centre, Thailand (IOI Thailand) the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources, Thailand from July 1 to 29, 2025 in Phuket, Thailand.
